description: This Java source file contains various behavior-driven JUnit test cases for the Concept class within the OpenMRS API project. The tests cover functionality related to concept names, descriptions, concept sets, synonyms, locale-specific methods, object state modifications, and search operations, among others.

classes.name: ConceptTest
classes.description: This class contains a comprehensive suite of JUnit test methods for testing the behaviors and functionalities of the Concept class within the OpenMRS core, particularly focusing on name handling, descriptions, concept sets, synonyms, locale-specific methods, additions/removals, ordering, and search operations.

methods.name: createConcept
methods.description: Factory method to create and populate a Concept object with a fully specified and a short name in the given locale.

methods.name: createConceptName
methods.description: Factory method to create a ConceptName with specific properties such as ID, name, locale, type, and locale preference.
